fusions.name: Tail Through the Straw
fusions.desc: You run a burning circle through every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 10 fire damage and setting each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 4 tiles of it, and you move 25% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bitten to Cinders
fusions.desc: A biting weapon strike that uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 16 fire damage and 50% more for each one used, and sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Trail of Embers
fusions.desc: Lays a line of embers 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after laying it.

fusions.name: Sparks at the Heels
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, a spark leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 4 lightning damage and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
